content.text: Managers currently export SLA breach CSVs by hand each Monday. They want an automated weekly report grouped by queue.

Build a scheduled report that runs Monday 06:00 workspace time, lists breach counts and median minutes past SLA per queue for the prior 7 days, and emails subscribed managers a CSV plus a short HTML summary. Done when two pilot queues (Billing Questions and Triage) receive correct numbers for a shadow week matching the manual export within 1%.
